name: sqlite_db
description: Query and inspect SQLite databases locally with table formatting
author: locaLLM Team

function.name: sqlite_query
function.description: Execute a SQL query (SELECT, etc.) on a local SQLite database and return formatted results

db_path.description: Path to SQLite database file (e.g. 'data.db', 'app.sqlite', or absolute path)

query.description: SQL query string to execute (e.g. 'SELECT * FROM users LIMIT 10')

function.name: sqlite_schema
function.description: Inspect all tables, column definitions, and schema of a local SQLite database
